xml_content: <TEI xmlns='http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0'><seg xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" type="excerpt" status="unreviewed" xml:id="exX0062023-05-2610-01-36">'di ni bzung ba tsam bden pa bkag nas 'dzin pa'ang bden par grub pa 'gog pa'i gzhung yin pa la <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:unnamed_reference" ref="db:4593">yab sras rnams</rs> na re | shu lo ka gcig po 'dis dbu ma'i lta ba bsgrubs pa yin no zhes gsungs pa ni | dbu ma'i lta ba la sbyar du <lb n="43b3"/> mi rung [\[]pa [;]ba [\]]ma yin mod | sems tsam rnam med pa'i gzung 'dzin dang rnam pa bden pa 'gog pa'i skabs yin par shin tu gsal te| brtsod [\[-]pa [\]]spang na yang | sems tsam rnam med pa'i grub mtha' la rtsod pa spangs kyi | dbu ma pa la brtsod pa spang bar mi snang ba'i phyir ro ||</seg></TEI>
